title: Camtono
text: Attached unit gains: “When Attack Ends: Look at the top card of your deck. If it costs 2 or less, you may play it for free.”
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
When Attack Ends abilities trigger at the same time as units deal combat damage. The attached unit does not need to survive the attack in order to resolve the ability.
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.
